title: Strict normalized local models for the actual integral Tate tensor
statement: For any Noetherian scheme T with ell invertible, and every natural tensor power d, the actual integral root tensor has an AdicTower whose underlying strict derived tower is exactly strictDerivedTower. There are level isomorphisms to the finite shifted twists satisfying ProjectionNormalized. One stratification and uniform model have lower=upper=-2d. All comparable-pair squares hold for every root-generator-normalized coefficient comparison; intrinsic and fixed coefficient cohomology is constructible. At d=0 the empty tensor comparison, followed by finiteZeroIso, respects the specified coefficient unitReduction. No reconstruction or exceptional assertion is included. Uses [def-pur-condensed-tate-integral-tower-data], [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower].

proof.text: Obtain the actual strict normalized AdicTower, its finite level identifications, normalized coefficient comparisons and every comparison square from the derived reduction component. This leaves common models and constructibility to the separate local-model statement.
Apply the local-model component to that very tower and those same level identifications and squares. Retain its common single-degree model, equal bounds and both constructibility clauses.

Apply the zero tensor unit comparison to the same tower, normalization squares and coefficient comparisons from the first step. It uses only naturality and the actual scalar-unit formulas; retain its result as the last conjunct and assemble all witnesses.

proof_origin.place: Normalized reduction and common-model components; explicit proof of the zero tensor unit equation

lean.statement:
theorem normalizedTateTensorTower
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime]
    (hT : IsUnit (ell : Γ(T, ⊤))) (d : ℕ) :
    ∃ (M : AdicTower T (datum.{u} ell))
      (e : ∀ n : ℕ, M.level n ≅ (derivedRealization T ell n).obj (finiteTwist T ell n d))
      (h : M.tower = strictDerivedTower T ell d),
      ProjectionNormalized T ell hT d M e h ∧
      ∃ (S : Stratification T) (W : UniformAdicTowerData (datum.{u} ell) M S),
        W.lower = -(2 * (d : ℤ)) ∧ W.upper = -(2 * (d : ℤ)) ∧
        (∀ (b a : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b)
          (r : CoefficientLineComparison
            (FiniteReduction.quotient.{u} ell (Nat.add_le_add_right hab 1))
            (ell ^ (b + 1)) (ell ^ (a + 1))
            (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) T),
          (pbcDerivedExtend (pbcAdicQuotient T (datum.{u} ell) b a hab)).map (e b).hom ≫
              (scalarComparison T ell b a hab).hom.app (finiteTwist T ell b d) ≫
              (derivedRealization T ell a).map (proTwistMap d r) =
            (M.normalization b a hab).hom ≫ (e a).hom) ∧
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
          @IsConstructibleProEtaleCoefficientModuleSheaf T (Ring.{u} ell ⧸
              (datum.{u} ell).ideal ^ (n + 1)) _ ((datum.{u} ell).quotientFinite n)
            ((pbcRestrict (pbcLevelConstantComparison T (datum.{u} ell) n).hom).obj
              ((_root_.DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj (M.level n)))) ∧
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
          IsConstructibleProEtaleFixedModuleSheaf T (coefficient ell (n + 1))
            ((_root_.DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj (finiteTwist T ell n d))) ∧
        ∀ hd : d = 0, ∀ (b a : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b),
          let e₀ (n : ℕ) := e n ≪≫ (derivedRealization T ell n).mapIso
            (eqToIso (congrArg (finiteTwist T ell n) hd) ≪≫ finiteZeroIso T ell n);
          (pbcDerivedExtend (pbcAdicQuotient T (datum.{u} ell) b a hab)).map (e₀ b).hom ≫
              (scalarComparison T ell b a hab).hom.app (𝟙_ _) ≫
              (derivedRealization T ell a).map (unitReduction T ell b a hab).hom =
            (M.normalization b a hab).hom ≫ (e₀ a).hom
